model_policy.reason: The 16 GB M1 Pro laptop recorded repeated IOGPUFamily kernel panics while the 14B MLX model used an estimated 10.86 GiB. Validated 14B cycles were preserved and remaining cycles used the installed 7B MLX coder at an estimated 5.60 GiB. The Mac mini profile keeps 14B.
